title: Ordinary direct-image normal forms for the unrestricted reference-rank predicate
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation, and let $E,F$ be finite locally free modules on $X$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. For every $s\in S$ there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $s$ such that one of the following holds. Either there is $r\in\mathbf N$ such that for every $g:T\to U$, the predicate $R_1(f,E,F,\iota_U\circ g)$ [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match] is equivalent to the ordinary direct image of the pullback of $F$ being finite locally free of rank $r$ after every further test $h:T^{\prime}\to T$; or for every $g:T\to U$ the same predicate is equivalent to $T$ being empty. The first alternative includes empty fibres with $r=0$; the second applies to mixed-rank fibres. No derived category or complex is part of this conclusion.

proof.text: The local rank loci of E are clopen. Their images and the image of X are clopen, by openness of a flat locally finitely presented map and proper closedness. If the fibre at s is nonempty of rank r, use the image of X minus the image of the complement of the rank-r locus. Pullback preserves ranks. Every further fibre is nonempty, so compare a local reference witness with r on a stalk. Invariant basis number forces the witness rank to equal r. Locality of fixed-rank freeness glues the direct-image witnesses; conversely a globally rank-r direct image supplies witnesses by restriction.

If the fibre at s is empty, use the complement of the image of X. Every base-changed source is empty, so its modules and their pushforwards are zero. A zero module is free of rank zero. Both the direct-image rank-zero assertion and the reference predicate hold on every test scheme, since the reference clause is on an empty source.

Otherwise select two different ranks a and c in the fibre and intersect their open images. Every fibre on this neighbourhood has points of both ranks. For a point of any nonempty test, the source of any reference witness also has points of these two ranks: nonempty fibre products of points persist under residue-field extension. A fixed-rank reference witness would force a=c by stalk finrank comparison. Thus the predicate implies emptiness of the test. On empty tests its quantified pointwise witnesses are vacuous. The three cases exhaust all fibres.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_picardRankMatchDirectImageNormalForm
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E F : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] [F.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (s : S) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧
      ((∃ r : ℕ, ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ U.toScheme),
        PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch f E F (g ≫ U.ι) ↔
          ∀ (T' : Scheme.{u}) (h : T' ⟶ T),
            SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
              ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g ≫ U.ι))).obj
                ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g ≫ U.ι))).obj F)) r) ∨
      (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ U.toScheme),
        PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch f E F (g ≫ U.ι) ↔ IsEmpty T))
